prompt:
Create one highest-quality polished native Flutter mobile app screen mockup for the Chinese commercial personal bookkeeping app 好好记账. One single flat portrait screenshot, approximately 393 x 852 logical pixels at high resolution. No physical phone, no perspective, no poster framing, no external design annotations. Chinese text must be accurate and comfortably readable, strong alignment and realistic touch targets.

Use the attached app screenshot ONLY for the established 好好绿 visual identity: warm pale cream background #FBFCF7, muted fresh green #76A33A, dark text #1E241C, white surfaces, soft subtle corners, thin green-gray rules and consistent simple outline icons. Keep its bottom navigation identity and labels 首页, 流水, central green circular plus button, 洞察, 我的 with 我的 active. Old content and old promotions must not be copied.

Composition candidate C: INTEGRATED ACCOUNT AND MEMBERSHIP. Balanced commercial account hub. Visibly integrate identity and membership inside ONE header region rather than putting membership in a separate banner halfway down the page.
Top chrome title 我的, message outline icon and settings gear on the right.
One compact white account header surface: top row circular avatar 陈, name 小陈, smaller 账号中心 ›; below the identity row a short pale-gold membership row within the SAME surface, crown icon, 基础版, right 会员中心 ›. A small ledger line shows 当前账本 · 生活账本 with a chevron. Header is restrained and compact, no huge hero artwork.
Directly beneath header, a clean unframed three-column record summary row, modest numerals 18, 4, 12, exact small labels 记账天数, 连续天数, 账单照片. These are illustrative sample values, no loyalty points, no levels, no financial balance.
Next section 常用功能, right 全部功能 ›. A 3-column by 2-row grid with six consistent thin green icons above exact labels: 我的账本, 账户资产, 自动记账, 账单导入, 预算管理, 分类管理. No individual tile boxes. Grid must fit compactly with comfortable touch targets.
Lower area one clean grouped navigable list with thin separators and right chevrons:
备份与数据, subtitle 云备份 · 本地备份 · 导入导出;
安全与隐私, subtitle 应用锁 · 权限设置;
帮助与反馈, subtitle 使用说明 · 我的工单.
Avoid a second redundant ledger management row because 我的账本 already exists in the shortcuts.
Fit all regions into one coherent first viewport above the established bottom dock, visually compact but not cramped. This composition should feel like one complete account-and-management page, with account and membership clearly grouped. No unrelated app recommendations, debug tools, development explanations, unsupported security claims, fake offers, testimonials, charts, progress rings or decorative imagery.
